newsitem.title: FRANCE: UPS French feeder flights hit by strike.
newsitem.headline: UPS French feeder flights hit by strike.

text.p: United Parcel Service (UPS) said its Thursday programme of intra-France feeder flights has been cancelled due to today's one-day strike by French air traffic controllers.
UPS operates five weekday feeder flights using Beechcraft 1900 aircraft able to carry two tonnes of cargo and leased, with their crew, from French airline, Air Littoral.

Two of the flights are between the express company's French hub at Paris-Charles de Gaulle airport to Nantes and to Strasbourg. The other three operate between its Lyon-Satolas airport sub-hub and Bordeaux, Toulouse and Nice.

"Normally, the five feeders leave CDG and Lyon for the provinces at around 0600 local time but this morning they were grounded and we have taken steps to ship freight by truck," a UPS official told Reuters.
UPS Boeing 727F services between Cologne and Paris and Lyon and Cologne had operated normally last night but this evening's flights look set to be hit, the official added.
There is hardly any air traffic at CDG at the moment and we are not really optimistic of the situation improving as the day goes on. We'll have to play it by ear," he said.
